entities.name: Philippe Antoine d'Ornano
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philippe Antoine d'Ornano, Comte d'Ornano was a French soldier and politician who fought in the French Revolutionary Wars and the Napoleonic Wars. He was made a Marshal of France in 1861.
